FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
TechBridge Solutions provides a range of IT consulting and support services tailored for small to medium-sized enterprises. Our core operations include remote and on-site technical support, software development, network management, and cybersecurity assessments. We specialize in ensuring compliance with data protection regulations and implementing strong security policies to mitigate risks. Our services also encompass IT training, data backup solutions, and the development of websites and applications, all performed in controlled environments. We prioritize maintaining solid vendor relationships and ensuring our operations do not include the use of computers for industrial machinery, aligning with standards that protect our clients and ourselves from undue risk.

Our company integrates sophisticated computer systems to manage and optimize the performance of production-type machinery in our manufacturing processes.
